policy: verbatim copies of the gamma package (flows: conditional neural spline flow, ActNorm, invertible 1x1 conv, RQS; td: BootstrapTarget, SingleStepGaussian, ReplayPool, Policy, format_batch, soft_update_from_to; utils; visualization base + pendulum) and the README's Colab notebook scripts/gamma-pendulum.ipynb (the fidelity recipe; read, not imported), plus LICENSE. Allowed edits: package-relative imports, and the listed P-route edits. Not vendored: gamma/visualization/video.py, setup.py, environment.yml / requirements.txt, scripts/gamma-pendulum-local.ipynb (local variant: burn-in disabled, 100k steps), data/ (copied to data/external/gamma_models with MANIFEST.json). Decision P-license: https://github.com/Sino-Huang/NovPhy/issues/134#issuecomment-6390841265
runtime_notes: torch 2.13: copy.deepcopy(model) (the notebook's target network) leaves the copied logistic prior unusable (Transform.__getstate__ drops _InverseTransform._inv; sampling raises 'AssertionError: _inv must not be None'). The adapter, the G-port reference and the fidelity runner let the target share the online model's prior object right after the deepcopy (the prior holds no parameters: Uniform(0, 1) through the inverse sigmoid). No file is edited (P-route).
torch.Tensor.lu (Invertible1x1Conv init) is deprecated in torch 2.13 (warning only; same factorisation).

On a GPU the flows build tensors with factory defaults (torch.zeros(m), torch.diag(torch.ones(dim)), the prior's Uniform bounds): upstream sets torch.set_default_tensor_type(torch.cuda.FloatTensor) via gamma.utils.set_device; the adapter builds the model seeded on CPU, then rebuilds it under torch.device(device) and loads the CPU state, and runs every call under torch.device(device).

edits: imports made package-relative: 'from gamma.utils.arrays import (' -> 'from ..utils.arrays import (' (line 6), plus 'from ..utils import arrays' (line 5) for the edit below

P-route compatibility: Policy.__init__ 'torch.load(loadpath)' -> 'torch.load(loadpath, map_location=arrays.DEVICE, weights_only=False)': torch >= 2.6 defaults to weights_only=True (the rlkit snapshot is a full pickle) and the released snapshot holds CUDA storages, which cannot load on a CPU host; arrays.DEVICE is the device set_device() selected (the notebook's set_device(args.device)). Numerically inert.
